state:
Goal `core-reflect-enuminfo-and-3-more`, 14 items, all in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs`.
`Core\Reflect\EnumInfo` is closed: all five members (`of`, `name`, `cases`, `valueOf`,
`isUnsigned`) have every proof on disk, and `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Reflect\EnumInfo'`
reports nothing owed and 0 failed. Its cards are in the plain voice.
The three checks still red are `Core\Reflect\MethodInfo`, `ParameterInfo` and `PropertyInfo`. Each
owes a class card (its `CoreClass` row has `doc: None` and its name is on
`CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`), and every member owes examples, an attack, a bench and a Rust test.
Several `.nvst` cases already call these members (`tests/conformance/core/reflect-*`) and need only
a `covers:` marker each, since instance members are not credited by a call.
A perf row is recorded with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only <ids>` after the bench runs; the
gate reports `perf: stale` until then. Nothing is blocked.
